notes.title: Small patch - More health less damage, bug fixes(again)
notes.notes: [h3]AI Improvements[/h3][p]The local Jarl's have grown tired of being the laughing stock of the entire game so they have upgraded themselves to be more formidable. [/p][list][*][p]AI Jarls now get passives[/p][/*][*][p]AI Jarls stats scale based on the year[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where a rune was dragging when you were dragging a Viking[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance [/h3][p]Due to a majority of fights being quick and one Viking cleaving entire teams, I have adjusted the following activities to help shift to more strategic fights to really show your clans builds.[/p][list][*][p]All Vikings health has been increased by 100[/p][/*][*][p]All Vikings base armor has been doubled[/p][/*][*][p]Merging Vikings now grants 20% of the merged Vikings stats(ex you merge a Viking that has 100 hp, it adds 20 hp to the Viking instead of 100)[/p][/*][*][p]Gold gained from killing Viking has been lowered from 2 to 1[/p][/*][*][p]Gold gained from the Goldmine has been increased across the board by 20-50%[/p][/*][*][p]Goldmine negative effects have been toned down, TNT blast still is high risk, high reward[/p][/*][*][p]Blacksmith rank effect has been changed from +1/+2 per rank to be +1 extra smash per rank. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]All player fights have been removed from the database to adjust for new balancing. [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed bug in ritual site where you could drag Viking after you sacrifice[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug in Odin Trail where you could drag after you started the trial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when you moved Viking from Odin Trial and Ritual site from the selected spot it would snap back but it wouldn't register it was in the selected spot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you lock the ritual site[/p][/*][*][p]Oathforged passive now correctly displays that it targets the front warrior[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tooltip for Voyage to show it unlocks in year 5 not 4[/p][/*][*][p]Updating match making system to help better match players in the first few years[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update #1 - Balance changes and bug fixs, resetting database
notes.notes: [p]Fixed the tavern bug preventing you from upgrading.[/p][p]Add rank nodes to Blacksmith, Hunting Grounds, Ritual and Goldmines.[/p][p]Changed cleave damage to be 30% on adjacent targets.[/p][p]Added in the Voyage nodes.[/p][p]Lowered the rune stat amounts to align better with the new stat scaling.[/p][p][/p][p]I will be resetting the database later today to remove all clans using the old stat scaling.[/p]

notes.title: Small patch: Adding double combat speed option
notes.notes: [p]Adding a new setting to speed up combat speed. Fixed some other text issues in the mines. I think I have addressed the tavern issues with Vikings getting removed when you merge units.[/p]

notes.title: Small Patch - Database improvements
notes.notes:
[p]Small update, database was getting hammered so I have fixed the query call to less stressful on the backend. Should not impact anything in game but will drop my read consumption a lot. 

Thanks to everyone has played and provided feedback on bugs and other issues. I will be address some of these bugs soon. Just trying to get the backend stable for the increased load from everyone playing now.[/p][p][/p][p]I also added in a small new mechanic for the hunting grounds. [/p][p][/p][p]-New Hunting Grounds Mechanic - Well Feed[/p][list][*][p]If you gather 20 or more rations from hunting, your clan is well feed[/p][/*][*][p]Well feed give you a random rune[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I also fixed your Jarl's name now being correct in the tavern.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone who has played![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: Fixed raid issue
notes.notes: [p]Raids were crashing the game after you finished the fight. Should be working now.[/p]

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: [p]Adjusted Tideblade base stats[/p][list][*][p]Increased max hp from 140 to 160[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered speed from 21 to 14[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered damage from 57 to 35[/p][/*][*][p]Raised armor from 7 to 20[/p][/*][/list][p]Adjusted Stoneguard[/p][list][*][p]Lowered armor gained from 20 to 15[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Increased all stat runes base values by 2-3 times, except for speed[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed some spelling issues on passives[/p]

notes.title: Small patch, new node
notes.notes: [p]Small patch[/p][p][/p][p]New Node: [/p][list][*][p]Odin's Mercy: Gain 2 lives, usable only once. Can only be used before year 6 and when on 1 life.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fix to bloodlust passive, not triggering when Vikings were bleeding[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed icons not spawning for energy and life nodes  [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 36 - All AI images have been removed, new starting passive
notes.notes:
[h2]⚔️ [b]Patch Notes – Version 36[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]🔥 Major Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]All AI-generated artwork has been removed[/b] from the game and store.
We’ve fully transitioned to handcrafted, original art to preserve the integrity and atmosphere of Raidbound.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧬 New Feature – [b]Jarl Synergy System[/b][/h3][p]Your chosen Jarl now grants role-based synergy bonuses to your crew from the start of the game:[/p][list][*][p][b]Raider[/b]: +10% Damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Warden[/b]: +15% Armor[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skirmisher[/b]: +1 Speed, +5% Damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserker[/b]: +3 Speed[/p][/*][/list][p]These bonuses stack with role effects and offer deeper strategic choices from the first turn.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌟 New System – [b]Experience & Progression[/b][/h3][p]A brand-new [b]experience system[/b] has been added:[/p][list][*][p]Gain XP from every action you take across battles, training, and exploration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock additional Jarls[/b] as you level up.[/p][/*][*][p]More unlocks and progression rewards coming soon![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ⚔️ Raidbound Patch Notes – The Great Overhaul
notes.notes:
[p]Prepare yourselves, Jarls! This week brings our [b]largest visual update yet[/b]. Nearly every piece of the game’s UI has been reforged, and the Viking warriors you command have shed their AI-born past for hand-crafted glory. The old gods approve.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667601/983ef4ce8d7645760fb30a16a52455722940f1f7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667601/7054ef910b6a6593d74b3f0dcc9a10aefeaefc1c.png"][/img][/p][h3]🌄 Major Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]All-New UI Across the Game[/b]
Every menu and screen has been reworked from the ground up. Cleaner, sharper, and more immersive than ever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Hover & Click Effects[/b]
UI elements now respond with satisfying effects when hovered or clicked—feels like real craftsmanship.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Viking Art[/b]
The AI-era is nearly gone. All Vikings have been visually remade with handcrafted sprites to match the Raidbound style.
[i](We’re almost fully free of AI art—just a few relics left to purge.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]🌀 Effects & Feedback[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Rune Appear Effects[/b]
Runes now emerge with a divine flourish worthy of their power.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ritual Site Visual Upgrade[/b]
New visual effects to capture the mystery and weight of sacrifice.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Odin’s Trial Visual Upgrade[/b]
The gods watch more closely now—expect a more dramatic experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Drag-and-Drop Logic[/b]
Items now ease back into place if not dropped into a valid slot. Smooth as a serpent.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p][b]Tutorial Hovering/Text Clean-Up[/b]
Clarity improved across the early-game guide. Fewer words, more wisdom.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed SFX Labeling Issues[/b]
Misplaced sound effects have been sorted into their proper categories.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster Resource Gathering[/b]
Mining and gathering times have been sped up. Your warriors work with newfound purpose.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to everyone testing, reporting, and playing. More updates soon—especially as we continue to purge the last remnants of AI from the world of [i]Raidbound[/i].[/p]

Yes — [b]any[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]💰 [b]Gold[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🍖 [b]Rations[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🌟 [b]Glory[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🩸 [b]Dishonor[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💀 [b]Lives[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Choose how much to risk… or go all in. notes.title: Raidbound – Small Update Now Live!
notes.notes: [p]A minor update is now live with a few quality-of-life improvements and new effect additions for your Vikings. Here's what's new:[/p][h2][b]🔧 Gameplay Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]🧭 [b]Voyage Node[/b] now unlocks [b]after Day 3[/b], giving you time to build strength before setting sail.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Improved Drag & Drop[/b] across multiple grids — you can now drag Vikings smoothly between locations. If you release them without placement, simply [b]click to return them[/b] to a valid grid.[/p][/*][*][p]🌟 [b]New background particles[/b] added to [b]Victory and Defeat screens[/b] for a more dynamic visual finish.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]✨ New Tier 1 Effects[/b][/h2][p]We’ve added five new frontline-triggered effects to expand your build possibilities:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p]Tier[/p][/th][th][p]Name[/p][/th][th][p]Effect Description[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]1[/p][/td][td][p][b]Ironline[/b][/p][/td][td][p]On attack, frontline Viking gains [b]+25 Armor[/b].[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]1[/p][/td][td][p][b]Berserker's Gift[/b][/p][/td][td][p]On attack, frontline Viking gains [b]+10 Damage[/b].[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]1[/p][/td][td][p][b]Battle Rhythm[/b][/p][/td][td][p]On attack, frontline Viking gains [b]Haste for 2s[/b].[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]1[/p][/td][td][p][b]Vital Bond[/b][/p][/td][td][p]On attack, frontline Viking gains [b]+20 Max Health[/b].[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]1[/p][/td][td][p][b]Warden’s Breath[/b][/p][/td][td][p]On attack, frontline Viking gains [b]2 Regeneration stacks[/b].[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🃏 Coming Soon: The Gambler’s Den[/b][/h2][p]Next up: we're working on the [b]Gambler’s Den[/b] node — a high-risk, high-reward system that lets you [b]wager any resource[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Rations[/p][/*][*][p]Glory[/p][/*][*][p]Dishonor[/p][/*][*][p]Even your lives...[/p][/*][/list][p]Will you risk your last breath for one final shot at power? Or will the gods snuff out your run before fate turns?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667601/7f5fadd05ed94da856ea7b771d878da33db371df.png"][/img][/p]
